what: A rendered image of a printed receipt. NOT a photograph, and never to be presented as one.
renderer: headless chromium via playwright, 680x980 at deviceScaleFactor 1.6
format: PNG, deliberately. Our own probe classifies any jpg/webp/avif over 320px as photographic, so shipping this as a JPEG would make counter.real-photography fire on a picture nobody photographed. Exporting it as a PNG is how we avoid gaming our own rule with our own image.
typeface: IBM Plex Mono, the site's own shipping face, inlined as base64
contentSource: the live 4F2A-9C sample report, rebuilt from @slop/core and @slop/detectors-web
counterRulesEarned: none. counter.real-photography and counter.handmade-artifact require a real photograph or a real hand-made mark, and a render is neither. We do not claim them.
